name: Prof. Allen Bolourchi
bio: Allen Bolourchi leads AI research and product at Meta Superintelligence Labs (MSL), Fundamental AI Research (FAIR), and is an Adjunct Professor of Generative AI and NLP at the USC Viterbi School of Engineering, where he directs the capstone of the USC AI Minor (TAC 459), which he designed from the ground up. At Meta, his work spans frontier models, agentic AI, world models, computer-use agents, and multimodal intelligence. He also co-leads the development of Meta's open-weight model Muse Glimmer and has co-authored research with Yann LeCun and other FAIR researchers. Previously, he led AI/ML personalization for the App Store and Apple Arcade at Apple.

headline: AI Research, Product and Program Management at Meta Superintelligence Labs, FAIR
teaching_title: Adjunct Professor of Generative AI and NLP
bio_paragraphs: His teaching combines the technical foundations of generative AI and NLP with AI product strategy and hands-on development. The capstone brings together foundational concepts, analysis of AI businesses, and the design and demonstration of working AI products.
His research background includes predictive modeling, evolutionary optimization, and the analysis of complex systems. He has also worked as a machine learning research scientist at Caltech.
education: Ph.D. in Engineering, focused on AI and evolutionary algorithms — University of Southern California
M.S. in Electrical Engineering — University of Southern California
Master of Business Administration (MBA) — Technology/AI and Finance — UCLA Anderson School of Management

name: Prof. Reza Jafarkhani
bio: Reza Jafarkhani is a Senior Lecturer of Technology and Applied Computing at the USC Viterbi School of Engineering, specializing in machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data analytics. He teaches all courses in the USC AI Minor, helping students build AI capabilities from foundational concepts to advanced applications. With extensive experience teaching students across the program, he connects technical theory with practical implementation and guides learners as they develop their AI skills. He co-instructs TAC 459 with Professor Allen Bolourchi, bringing this broad teaching experience to the course's technical foundations and hands-on AI product development.

name: Rajeev Singh
bio: Rajeev Singh is a passionate software engineer with a robust background in full-stack development, cloud computing, and machine learning. Currently pursuing his Master’s in Computer Science at the University of Southern California, Rajeev has honed his skills through practical experiences that include designing CI/CD pipelines and building real-time applications. His tenure at companies such as ASML, where he enhanced system uptime and error resolution efficiency, highlights his ability to develop scalable systems and optimize infrastructure. Rajeev will be joining Meta as a Software Engineer from June 2025

name: Nitin Sai Bommi
bio: Nitin Sai Bommi is an emerging expert in deep learning and machine learning with a solid research and academic foundation. Having earned his Master’s degree from the University of Hyderabad—with a thesis focused on Explainable AI for Software Engineering—he is now advancing his studies at the University of Southern California. Nitin has built a diverse portfolio through internships at NVIDIA, where he is involved in deep learning performance analysis, as well as research roles at the University of Calgary, University College Dublin, and the University of Hyderabad. His proficiency in Python and machine learning, coupled with his hands-on experience in AI profiling and performance optimization, marks him as a promising innovator in the field. Nitin will be joining NVIDIA in May 2025 after his graduation.​

name: Varuna Krishna Kolla
bio: Varuna Krishna is a driven computer science professional with extensive experience in machine learning and artificial intelligence. Currently pursuing his Master’s in Computer Science at the University of Southern California, he also serves as a Teaching Assistant for the Applied Machine Learning for Natural Language Processing course. His professional journey includes impactful roles such as a Generative AI Engineer Intern at Vimaan, Machine Learning Intern at AutomationEdge, and a research internship at the University of South Carolina’s Artificial Intelligence Institute. Varuna’s work on projects like Image2Tweet and innovative joint embedding learning techniques underlines his commitment to advancing AI. With robust programming skills in C, HTML, and Python, he is well-equipped to tackle complex technical challenges and contribute to the tech industry. Varuna will be joining Amazon as a Software Developer from June 2025.
